title: Product Execution Surface
description: Frontmatter and section contract for the product → execution surface. product/product.md is the living product index and current-state summary; product/roadmap.md sequences work; product/features/*.md supplies executable feature specs. Product artifacts may cite external product sources, but the local artifact remains the durable contract.

status.description: Status of this product artifact. product.md and roadmap.md are normally current; feature specs use planned, active, shipped, paused, or deprecated.

last_reviewed.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this product surface was last reviewed for execution readiness.

source_draft.description: Relative path to the business draft that most recently changed this product surface, if any.

feature_id.description: Stable feature identifier. Required by convention for product/features/*.md so execution tasks can reference the feature they implement.

external_sources.description: External product sources this artifact depends on. Use for design tools, prototypes, research repositories, feedback systems, analytics dashboards, support systems, planning tools, or other non-repo sources.

product_md_required_body_sections.heading: Product Summary
product_md_required_body_sections.description: Current product definition: target users, core value, active scope, and product boundaries.

product_md_required_body_sections.heading: Active Scope
product_md_required_body_sections.description: What is currently in scope, out of scope, and intentionally deferred.

product_md_required_body_sections.heading: Feature Index
product_md_required_body_sections.description: Links to product/features/*.md entries with stable feature IDs.

product_md_required_body_sections.heading: Constraints
product_md_required_body_sections.description: Technical, product, business, compliance, and UX constraints that scope the work.

product_md_required_body_sections.heading: Priority Model
product_md_required_body_sections.description: How product priorities are ordered and interpreted.

roadmap_required_body_sections.heading: Now
roadmap_required_body_sections.description: Committed or active product bets and milestones.

roadmap_required_body_sections.heading: Next
roadmap_required_body_sections.description: Likely next bets, sequencing dependencies, and decision gates.

roadmap_required_body_sections.heading: Later
roadmap_required_body_sections.description: Deferred opportunities that are known but not yet committed.

feature_required_body_sections.heading: User Problem
feature_required_body_sections.description: The concrete user problem or job this feature solves.

feature_required_body_sections.heading: Acceptance Criteria
feature_required_body_sections.description: Observable criteria execution tasks must satisfy.

feature_required_body_sections.heading: Dependencies
feature_required_body_sections.description: Product, design, codebase, or sequencing dependencies.

feature_required_body_sections.heading: Evidence
feature_required_body_sections.description: Links to feedback, requirements, design contracts, external sources, decisions, business drafts, or codebase evidence supporting this feature.
